title: A customer moved from a blank term reads "from COD" in its note
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Due on Receipt is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has a blank credit term (it counts under COD).
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-11 Blank.
  • Your user name is {User-A}.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-11 Admin.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "COD" row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Click "Select None".
  4. Type {Customer-A}'s name in "Search customers".
  5. Tick {Customer-A}.
  6. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  7. Open {Customer-A}'s customer page.
  8. Click the "Notes" tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from COD" opens.
  • Step 3: "0 selected" (every customer on the term is unticked, including those not in view).
  • Step 4: only {Customer-A} is listed.
  • Step 5: "1 selected".
  • Step 6: "Move To" was prefilled with Due on Receipt; the toast "1 customer moved to Due on Receipt." shows.
  • Step 7: the page opens.
  • Step 8: the note reads "Credit term changed from COD to Due on Receipt by {User-A} (Move Customers)."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R11: “Each moved customer gets a note on its Notes, authored by the user who moved it, reading "Credit term changed from {old term} to {new term} by {user name} (Move Customers)." A customer moved from a blank term reads "from COD".”
  • S1-R12: “The Customers column shows how many customers hold the term, right aligned, showing 0 when none. The Counter Sale customer is never counted. A customer with a blank term is counted under COD. Names that differ only in capitals and spaces count toward the same term ("NET 30" counts as Net 30; see §6).”
